headline: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack

scenes.vo: The American government just moved to take back over one point two billion dollars stolen in the Binance hack. Here's what changed.
The Justice Department says a court approved seizing or restraining that money. It's part of over two point seven billion dollars frozen, out of more than six billion stolen.
Here's why traders are watching it. It's the biggest legal step yet toward recovering funds from North Korea's hackers.
The catch. The FBI also took down a North Korean scheme called Face Stealer. It used hijacked accounts and fake video calls to steal over four hundred million dollars.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether the money reaches victims, and be wary of any surprise video call asking you to install software.
